name: Runline
description: A neural-feed drama following the members of a mid-tier runner crew called the Saltwall Irregulars, operating across Tier 1 through Tier 3 in the industrial corridors between the Shelf and the lower Spire. Critically lauded for its procedural authenticity — the showrunner, Davorin Achebe-Ström, spent two years embedded with actual courier networks before production — the show renders the neural experience of a run in real time, including the adrenaline, the dead drops, the negotiation with hostile territory, and the quiet grief of losing crew members to corponation enforcement. Now in its fourth season.
cultural_impact: Sparked a significant cultural rehabilitation of runner crews in mainstream Meridian 88 media, shifting public perception from criminal framing toward a more complex view of the grey-economy workforce.
story_hooks: The Saltwall Irregulars depicted in the show are real — and they're furious about how accurately the show has mapped their routes and methods
Season 5 was abruptly cancelled mid-production; the final unaired episodes are on a physical drive that the showrunner hid before disappearing
A corporate fixer is attending Runline fan events, looking for people whose knowledge of the show's details suggests they might have actual runner connections
